pattern.name: Wool cloud folds
pattern.description: Large scalloped seams gather at the left and lower edges like lightly pressed wool. The lobes remain open and uneven, avoiding both a repeated grid and the octopus curling channels.

background.status: Selected presentation for the owner-authorized framing repair. Background is independent of the animal and existing website theme.

framing.note: Uniform 92% portrait placement anchored to the bottom. No stretched anatomy or cloned edge samples. Protected feature clearance is measured separately from intentional shoulder entry. This first pass evaluates extraction and placement before any necessary minor side continuation.

matte.calibrationNote: Sampled native exterior matte; connected extraction preserves enclosed eye details and warm ivory anatomy. Only sub-32-pixel isolated threshold residue may be removed; the animal and all retained accessories form one continuous identity.
